name: archidep
description: Media engineering architecture and deployment course
author: Simon Oulevay <simon.oulevay@heig-vd.ch>

scripts.doctoc:root: doctoc --github --notitle CONTRIBUTING.md README.md TEST-MATTER.md course/CONTRIBUTING.md theme/CONTRIBUTING.md && prettier --write CONTRIBUTING.md README.md TEST-MATTER.md course/CONTRIBUTING.md theme/CONTRIBUTING.md
scripts.doctoc:app: doctoc --github --notitle app/CONTRIBUTING.md app/docs/*.md app/lib/archidep/accounts/CONTRIBUTING.md app/lib/archidep/course/CONTRIBUTING.md app/lib/archidep/course_site/CONTRIBUTING.md app/lib/archidep/servers/CONTRIBUTING.md app/lib/archidep_web/CONTRIBUTING.md && prettier --write app/CONTRIBUTING.md app/docs/*.md app/lib/archidep/accounts/CONTRIBUTING.md app/lib/archidep/course/CONTRIBUTING.md app/lib/archidep/course_site/CONTRIBUTING.md app/lib/archidep/servers/CONTRIBUTING.md app/lib/archidep_web/CONTRIBUTING.md
scripts.format: npm run format:root && npm run --workspace course format
scripts.format:write: npm run format:root:write && npm run --workspace course format:write
